part.text:
Fixed the bug in `src/object.c:1074` by reading stream ID deltas as `int64_t` instead of `int`, preventing truncation when listpack entries have large deltas from their master ID.

Validated with the reported `XTRIM MINID` reproduction and the full `unit/type/stream` test suite—all passed.
